subject: Request: one-time trial uplift + 90-day POC extension (NovoHealth)
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial uplift + extension request — urgent

Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost profile look promising for our inference workloads. We kicked off an internal smoke test yesterday and quickly ran into two blockers:

- Our token consumption is ~3x what we estimated because a few of our Q&A flows are long-context.
- We need a longer runway to prove integration with our PHI handling and De-ID pipeline (security review is taking longer than expected).

We are still very interested and want to keep momentum, but the PLG sandbox limits are too tight for the end-to-end validation our compliance team requires. Can Redwood make a one-time trial uplift (additional free credits) and extend the POC window by 90 days? If needed I can put this on a purchase order or letter of intent — we want to avoid a hard stop during validation.

Quick context: NovoHealth is a 1200-employee digital health provider; primary integration is proof-of-concept for chart summarization across EHR exports. We have an internal timeline aiming for an internal demo to execs in mid-Oct.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of whether this is possible and who I should coordinate with.

—Carlos
Carlos Mendez
CTO, NovoHealth
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novohealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial uplift + extension request — urgent

Carlos — thanks for the quick note and the details, and really glad the demo landed. I can absolutely signal support here. Before I escalate for one-time approval, could you confirm two quick things so I can include them in the ask:

1) Estimated additional token need for the 90-day window (ballpark is fine).
2) Any compliance artifacts we should be aware of (SOC2 type, encryption/KMS needs) — you mentioned De-ID but want the specific checklist items.

If you can send a short email with those two bullets I will kick off an internal approval ASAP. Meanwhile I’ll propose an interim offer: if we approve this, Redwood can provide up to 200k free-generation tokens and extend the sandbox by 90 days as a one-time exception, subject to exec sign-off and a quick mutual action plan. I will attach an MAP draft to the internal thread.

Best,
Irene

Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Aditya — forwarding from NovoHealth (Carlos Mendez). Quick summary and ask:

Irene / team / Carlos — OK to proceed under the constraints below. Appreciate the clear MAP and the usage snapshot; that helped. Final decision and terms: 

- Approved: one-time free uplift of 200,000 generation tokens.
- Approved: 90-day sandbox extension starting 2028-07-22.
- Conditions: NovoHealth must sign the attached MAP within seven calendar days and submit either a PO or an LOI that outlines expected procurement timing. - Limitations: No SLA or Guaranteed Capacity included in this exception. Any request for guaranteed latency/fixed throughput moves to Dedicated + Sales + Solutions and will require a commercial contract.

Jordan — please log this concession in Deal Desk and set up a usage alert (email to sales-engagement and finance) at 80% of the uplift. Laura — please attach the final MAP to HubSpot deal DH-2028-0719 and confirm the template aligns with Finance. Irene — confirm to Carlos and include the MAP and the HubSpot link in your reply.
